Brands That Accept Creators with No Followers (2026)

You don't need thousands of followers to get PR packages. In fact, dozens of brands actively seek creators with zero or minimal followings — they want authentic voices, not inflated numbers. This list focuses specifically on brands with no follower minimums.

Why Brands Work with 0-Follower Creators

It sounds counterintuitive, but many brands specifically want creators with small or no followings. Here's why:

  • UGC content: Brands need authentic content for their ads. They don't care about your followers — they want your face and voice for their marketing.
  • Product reviews: Amazon sellers and D2C brands need honest reviews. Your opinion matters more than your reach.
  • Building relationships early: Smart brands invest in creators before they blow up. They're betting on your potential.
  • Diverse content: Brands want content from real people, not just polished influencers with ring lights.
  • Cost efficiency: Working with new creators costs brands less, so they take more chances.

The key is positioning yourself as a content creator, not an influencer. You're selling your creative skills, not your audience.

How to Pitch Brands with No Following

Your pitch needs to focus on what you CAN offer, not what you don't have:

1. Lead with Content, Not Numbers

Don't apologise for having no followers. Instead:

  • "I create UGC-style content for brands to use in their marketing"
  • "I'm building my portfolio and would love to feature [Brand]"
  • "I specialise in [specific content type] — here are examples"

2. Create Sample Content First

Before pitching, create 2-3 "spec" pieces showing what you can do:

  • Film a product review with products you already own
  • Create an unboxing-style video (even if you bought the product)
  • Show your editing skills with before/after content

3. Offer Value Beyond Posting

Brands can use your content even if you don't post it:

  • "You're welcome to use this content in your ads"
  • "I can provide raw footage for your marketing team"
  • "Happy to create multiple versions for A/B testing"

Sample Pitch for Zero-Follower Creators

"Hi [Brand]! I'm a UGC creator building my portfolio with brands I genuinely love. I've been using [specific product] for [time period] and would love to create content showcasing it — you'd be welcome to use the content in your marketing. I create [content type] and can turn around content within [timeframe]. Here's my portfolio: [link]. Would you be open to a gifted collaboration? Happy to discuss what would work best for you."

FAQ

Can I really get PR packages with 0 followers?

Yes. Many brands care more about content quality than follower count. Programs like Influenster, BzzAgent, and Amazon Vine have no follower requirements. Fashion brands like Shein accept creators with any following size. The key is positioning yourself as a content creator, not an influencer.

What should I put in my pitch if I have no followers?

Focus on what you CAN offer: content creation skills, genuine enthusiasm for the brand, quick turnaround times, and willingness to provide content for their marketing use. Never apologise for your follower count — many brands specifically want UGC creators, not influencers.

Should I buy followers to look more established?

Never. Brands can easily spot fake followers (engagement rate gives it away), and it destroys trust immediately. A creator with 200 real followers and 8% engagement is infinitely more valuable than one with 10K fake followers and 0.1% engagement.

How long until I start getting PR packages?

With consistent pitching (10-15 brands per week), most creators receive their first PR package within 2-4 weeks. Product review programs like Influenster may take 1-2 months to start sending VoxBoxes. Patience and persistence matter more than follower count.

What's the difference between UGC and influencer content?

Influencer content is posted on YOUR account to YOUR audience. UGC (user-generated content) is created for BRANDS to use on THEIR channels and ads. UGC doesn't require any followers because the brand is using your content, not your reach. Many 0-follower creators make good money doing UGC.
